The enemy arrives where you were standing. You are already slipping through the space beside them.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self after a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to you.
Type
Skill / Movement / Defense

Move up to 2 squares without provoking. If your endpoint offers actual concealment, you may attempt to Hide there as part of this Reaction.
